parameters: Tidereavers, the mark is hiding out at Granheim Abbey, and there's a mountain of gold waitin' to reward \n[27] bounty!\! I don't care if you burn the place to ashes... I want \n[8]'s pretty little blue head.
Oh my stars...\| Look, a baby dragon! What a sweet thing!
Yes, it's scared, too...\| What are you doing here, dear dragon??
Tidereavers were probably lookin' to sell it. The grown ups go for a king's ransom, y'know.\! No surprise considerin' the devastation they can bring.
Sister Diana... please allow me to care for this dragon.
Of course, Sister Abigayle. This dragon is a lucky one to have you.
Oh my stars... that's quite a love bite!\! A little softer next time? Maybe I shall call you...\| Nibbler!

note:
dragon racher rescued from goal

can trigger rockslides

Teach terror - enemies avoid Diana (you know where they aren't going to go)
